author: GameTrailers
description: Watch as Charlie takes on Dahlia in this latest Dead As Disco boss fight gameplay video for the neon-drenched beat ‘em up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Trailer for Koromi, a 3D action platformer developed by Super Seeded. Players will master the game's free flow across scenic locations to uncover the jungle's secrets. Koromi is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Koromi - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at gameplay and more from Lostbound in this latest trailer for the upcoming dark roguelite action RPG, where the world itself disappears behind you. Lostbound will be available on PC via Steam on October 6, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.

In Lostbound, exploration comes with a unique risk. The more players move through the world, the more it begins to crumble in their wake, with previously explored paths disappearing as The Hand advances.

Players must constantly decide where to go next, balancing exploration against the need to stay ahead of their relentless pursuer. Push too far and risk losing the route home, or turn back while there's still a way out.
title: Lostbound - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for Luminous Nights, a fast-paced hack-and-slash action game developed by Yahya Danboos. Players will explore the city of Noor to master platforming challenges, engage in fast-paced action combat, and take on the Masked King. Luminous Nights is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Luminous Nights - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at gameplay and the world of Stonefeather in this latest trailer for the upcoming atmospheric flying adventure built around physics-based movement and exploration. In Stonefeather, take to the skies in a mysterious world where the wind has disappeared, exploring ancient ruins, encountering animal spirits and gradually uncovering the secrets of a world waiting to be awakened. Stonefeather will be available on PC. A demo launches on Steam on October 8, 2026.
title: Stonefeather - Official Demo Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss 'The Hunger' Live Action Trailer for The Blood of Dawnwalker, a third-person action-adventure RPG developed by Rebel Wolves. Players will traverse an open-world 14th-century Europe where a choice must be made: resist the temptation or give in to the thirst. The Blood of Dawnwalker is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: The Blood of Dawnwalker - Official 'The Hunger' Live Action Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Broken Shell is a short, hand-drawn puzzle adventure about two hermit crabs searching for a place to call home. Explore a vibrant underwater world, solve gentle puzzles, and experience a heartfelt story told entirely without words. Broken Shell will be available on PC.
title: Broken Shell - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Waltz and Jam is an action-adventure platformer game following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins. The new Waltz and Jam trailer showcases gameplay, characters, and more of its world.

Waltz and Jam will be available on PC.
title: Waltz and Jam - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Vem, Exu is a short narrative experience where you solve simple puzzles and explore a world where emotions become interaction. After losing his kite in a fight with his brother, Exu tries to sleep while carrying his anger. During the night, his feelings take the form of a storm where dream and reality mix. As he crosses this world, he must face his own pride and come to terms with what he feels in order to return. Vem, Exu will be available on Google Play and Steam. A demo is available now.

Watch the Vem, Exu trailer to see what to expect. Vem, Exu will be available on Android (Google Play) and PC (Steam). A demo is available now.
title: Vem, Exu - Official Updated Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into Truth Scrapper in this latest trailer for the upcoming mystery romance visual novel from insertdisc5, the creator of In Stars and Time. 

In Truth Scrapper, Sosotte, a member of the titular guild, is sent to investigate a series of attacks in a town built around a vast sink hole. Two people are eager to guide her; prime-and-proper Betz, and carefree Amour. The catch is that at the end of each day, Sosotte forgets everything except for what's written down in her magic book. You choose what Sosotte remembers, and what (or who) she forgets.  These memories, and perspectives, impact how she views and interacts with the world around her, steering her towards unique scenes and interactions, and one of three distinct story paths over seven days. 

Truth Scrapper will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Truth Scrapper - Official Overview Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a closer look at gameplay and the story of Toada Brava in this latest trailer for the upcoming fully hand-drawn 2D top-down RPG. In Toada Brava, battle your way through the Santacrúz Dungeons and help Kako find his mom, while helping the revolution!

Toada Brava will be available on PC.
title: Toada Brava - Official Gameplay and Story Overview Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Treetopians is a cozy colony simulator where players build vertical villages in the treetops and care for a growing community of villagers with unique needs and personalities. Check out the latest Treetopians trailer to see its colorful world and more. Treetopians will be available on PC and Xbox Series X/S. A demo is out now.
title: Treetopians - Official Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
The InBetween is a hand-drawn Metroidvania with challenging platforming where you explore a dying and Infested land, gain new abilities, fight epic bosses, and decide whether to spare or kill the Infected, shaping both your conscience and your story. 

The InBetween will be available on PC, Mac, and Xbox Series X/S in October 2026.
title: The InBetween - Official Release Window Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Step into the shoes of Clementine "Cleo" Ace, an apprentice to her aunt, the world-renowned detective, Maya Lynch. From heists to murders, use your deduction skills to solve "howdunnit" cases that are too tough for the local police to crack and uncover a deeper mystery along the way! 

The Detective's Apprentice will be available on PC (Steam).
title: The Detective's Apprentice - Official Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a closer look at T.W.I.R.L. in this latest trailer for the psychological horror game. It's 3 AM in your childhood home. The year is 2006. Everyone's asleep, but you. Sneak out of your room and do as you're told - "T.W.I.R.L." - whatever that means. 

T.W.I.R.L. is available now on Steam.
title: T.W.I.R.L. - Official Overview Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch! 

Sucker for Love: Crush Landing is available now on PC via Steam.
title: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing - Official Launch Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Splash Divers trailer for this upcoming cozy exploration game. Splash Divers will be available on PC. 

In Splash Divers, dive freely without worrying about oxygen limits, countdowns, or combat as you explore colorful underwater environments and discover a variety of marine life. Use your camera to capture memorable moments and build your own ocean encyclopedia as you encounter everything from schools of tropical fish to playful and unpredictable sea creatures. Back on the island, collect shells and other treasures, meet fellow divers from around the world, and create a personalized diving journal with photos, stickers, and memories from your adventures.
title: Splash Divers - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Tower Tactics 2 gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and an early access release date. Check out the Tower Tactics 2 release date trailer for this upcoming sequel to Tower Tactics: Liberation. Tower Tactics 2 fuses the strategic depth of deck-building roguelikes with the action of tower defense. Tower Tactics 2 launches into Early Access on PC on October 8, 2026.

In Tower Tactics 2, the Sal'koth invasion threatens the universe once again. Guided by Kaya, a new generation of heroes must uncover what is happening, strengthen their abilities and fight their way through increasingly dangerous encounters. As they complete quests and discover new powers, they will have to overcome the Sal'koth and ultimately find a way to save the universe.
title: Tower Tactics 2 - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers

Players will traverse a haunted library and organize thousands of real books in their rightful place on the shelf. Organize them by adhering to the Dewey Decimal System classification, author, and title, clean the library, and encounter the horrors within. Something is Wrong with the Library is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Something is Wrong with the Library - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Five family units are coming to Jurassic World Evolution 3: Prehistoric East, and you can get a look at them in this new trailer for the upcoming expansion of the dinosaur park management game. In Jurassic World Evolution 3, build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.
title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Prehistoric East - Official Species Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the Yangchuanosaurus and see this intimidating theropod in action in this Jurassic World Evolution 3: Prehistoric East trailer for the upcoming expansion of the dinosaur park management sim game. Jurassic World Evolution 3 is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S. Jurassic World Evolution 3: Prehistoric East will be available on September 29, 2026.

During the Jurassic period, the Yangchuanosaurus sat at the top of the food chain with powerful jaws and distinctive tusk protruding from the sides of its mouth. 

In Jurassic World Evolution 3, build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.
title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Prehistoric East - Official Yangchuanosaurus Gameplay Trailer
